title: KEYS Research Internship
who_text: Arizona high school students who are 16 or older by the first day, are U.S. citizens or permanent residents, and have lived in Arizona for at least one year
description: A summer research internship where you work on real science projects with University of Arizona researchers. The 2027 program runs June 7 to July 23, costs nothing to join, and earns 3 units of college credit. Applications open November 2, 2026, and recommendations are due January 7.
